svg.title: Two attention heads of the trained model
svg.desc: Each row is a token, and the color shows how much it reads from each token before it. Stronger is more.
svg.text: Two attention heads of the trained model
Each row is a token, and the color shows how much it reads from each token before it. Stronger is more.
Tokens tend to look at the one just before
The upper right is empty: a token cannot attend to the tokens after it. Head numbers count from zero.
